## Description

Rework the onboarding wizard (web/clinic/src/features/onboarding) to the 6 Nov steps with the live booking-page preview: 1 your practice (type, specialties, registration number by country rules), 2 hours and services (prefilled from the specialty, appointment length, services and fees in minor units), 3 your team (invite nurse, doctor, front desk with the "front desk never sees clinical notes" line), 4 your patients (upload a spreadsheet, ask us to move data, or start fresh), 5 payments and messages (connect now or later), and the ready screen (book your first patient, or try a sample day with 3 synthetic patients you can delete). Keeps autosave, resume, "Finish later", skip and server-side checks from MDV-P1-004. Steps whose back end is not built yet (spreadsheet import, payment connections) record the choice and link to Settings; each such limit is a recorded shortcut.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an owner leaves at any step, when they sign in again, then the wizard resumes at that step with their answers (autosave).
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a step, when it is submitted, then the server validates it with the country rules and shows errors under the field, announced to screen readers.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the team step, when an owner invites a front-desk member, then the invitation is sent with the front-desk role and that role cannot open clinical notes (server-side test).
- [ ] **AC4.** Given "try a sample day", when chosen, then 3 synthetic patients are created that the owner can delete, and real patients are never mixed with them.
- [ ] **AC5.** Every step is keyboard-complete, 44 px targets, axe clean in en, hi and ar; Arabic is right to left.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
